implemented: The memory product module uses the existing upload, archive, import worker and transactional domain services for facts, topics, private instructions, imported summaries and fact/topic source revisions.
Mappings, selected conflict decisions and receipts use actual resource kinds; memory results expose resourceSection while existing care/profile/task results keep their previous shape.

Imported summaries remain append-only historical records in the original summary collection, with original coverage and provenance. They never create an active local head or advance local message coverage.

Current read authorization, bounded source history export, physical deletion and independent-journal restore replay cover imported fact/topic evidence. Private instructions and summaries cannot be imported into shared access.
Restore metadata recognizes authenticated imported summaries and the existing summary batch query fields.

coverage: One connected synthetic archive/upload/formal import service and worker flow imports all six memory sections; normal reads, results and historical reads return the same records.
Repeating the package skips all six records; a local fact change conflicts, and selected-only replacement changes only that source resource.
Another account is rejected. Deletion hides the source revision immediately, the actual cleanup consumer removes it, and replay against a prior synthetic snapshot removes it again.
Imported summary updates retain the older snapshot and create a new local version without an active head.
The existing care source-history round-trip and deletion/restore flow still passes after the shared history changes.
